persona.backstory: He was set to watch the barred arch before the hall had walls, and he has not been relieved since.
persona.demeanor: Wary and unmoving at first; yields only to a traveler who asks rather than demands.
persona.motivation: Keep the yard shut until someone proves they mean to walk out into it.
persona.secret: He has never once looked through the door he guards.
persona.speech_style: Terse, formal, archaic; clipped declarations and no contractions.
